import { about } from '../content'
import { ImageSlot } from '../components/ImageSlot'

export function About() {
  return (
    <section className="section">
      <div className="container prose">
        <h1>{about.title}</h1>
        <p className="lead">{about.lead}</p>
        {about.body.map((p) => (
          <p key={p}>{p}</p>
        ))}
        <ImageSlot label="A picture of you or your place" file="about.jpg" size={[1200, 800]} />
        <h2 id="contact">{about.contactTitle}</h2>
        <p>{about.contact}</p>
      </div>
    </section>
  )
}
